lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.text: The river's calm tonight. It weren't always — before the pass fell, the boats used to run all the way to the coast.

lines.speaker: Old Woman
lines.text: Take care on the east road. Folk say watchtower pickets have sharp eyes and sharper steel.

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: If you clear the watchtower, the trade route opens again — and I'll sell to you at cost. Maybe.

lines.speaker: Child
lines.text: My pa says the Bandit Chief camps up in the ridge ruins. They say he's got more men than the fort.
